scope: Flag assets for the continued national, subnational and autonomous-territory viewing-source publication batch. Seven new full flags, one independently verified Community flag reuse, and three explicit neutral marks.
method: Checked primary flag-design descriptions and current Commons metadata, downloaded with a shared cache/serialized two-second pacing and increasing rate-limit backoff. Verified source SHA1, original and sanitized SHA256, XML safety and identical parsed artwork trees. Visually inspected a static side-by-side original/local contact sheet. No media playback was used. Copyright and official-symbol conditions are recorded separately.
